spec_basis: STU-VID-010: 'A sequence owns an ordered set of StudioTracks, a settings record, a time model, in/out points, a work area, and a marker list.'
STU-VID-020: clip fields 'transitions | Optional head and tail transition references ([STU-VID-032]).' and 'markers | Clip-local marker list.'; 'label_color | One of the 16 declared label colours'

STU-VID-032: 'StudioTransition (schema id hsk.studio.transition@1) carries: transition_kind (a filter_kind in the transition category of [STU-FX-126]), duration (ticks), alignment (centered_on_cut | start_at_cut | end_at_cut | custom), center_offset, and a typed parameter set obeying 14.9.1 in full.'
STU-VID-034: 'Each carries a name, a comment, a colour, a duration (a marker may be a span, not only a point), and an optional typed payload for chapter, web-link, cue-point and caption roles.'

STU-VID-040: 'Every operation in this sub-section is one reversible StudioHistoryEntry'; STU-HIS-002: undo 'by applying its inverse command or a snapshot revert'; STU-CON-022: later history owners 'MUST reuse these patch/precondition/inverse semantics rather than invent a conflicting patch grammar.'
decisions: undo mechanism: session document entries (selection/text/develop) are documented 'Not undoable and not a revision', so they cannot carry undo; chronicle's property table addresses only layers, artboards and page spreads (NodeKind), and adding NodeKind::Sequence would break exhaustive matches in interop-fig and interop-layout. The step is therefore a sequence-scoped snapshot revert with chronicle's precondition + inverse semantics, routed through session's existing submit pipeline (no fast path)
Rust type TimelineTransition: folio already has StudioTransition for the STU-PRO-116 prototype transition (reactions.rs); the wire schema id is the spec's hsk.studio.transition@1

a transition at a cut is stored once, as the outgoing clip's tail; marker and transition ids are document-local keys (no prefix declared); clip markers in source ticks (Studio readings, documented in timeline.rs)
transition_kind is an opaque key: no canonical filter_kind for cross dissolve is verified in STU-FX-126; tests use 'cross_dissolve' as a test value only
